senses.gloss:
Dundubhi
------------------------------------------
Born as the son of Mayāsura and Hemā, दुन्दुभि was a ferocious demon. Māyāvī was his brother and मण्डोदरी (the queen of रावण) was his sister.
Puffed up with the arrogance of strength acquired by austerities and boons, he challenged वरुण and Himavān (the kings of the oceans and the mountains) for a duel. They advised him to fight with Vālī, who would be the best adversary for him. However, Vālī ultimately killed him after a fierce fight.
Dundubhī was a Gandharva princess reborn as Mantharā (due to a curse) and served as the hand-maid of कैकेयी, the youngest queen of दशरथ. She was instrumental in creating the palace intrigues that led to the banishment of राम to the forest.
